INSERT INTO family_posts
(user_id, platform, content, post_time, topic_tag, target_person, is_shareable, reason, platform_post_id)
VALUES (
  {{$json.user_id}},                                   -- 數字不加引號
  'FB',
  {{ $json.content ? "'" + $json.content.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.post_time_fmt ? "TIMESTAMP '" + $json.post_time_fmt + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.topic_tag ? "'" + $json.topic_tag.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.target_person ? "'" + $json.target_person.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.is_shareable ?? 0 }},
  {{ $json.reason ? "'" + $json.reason.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.post_id ? "'" + $json.post_id.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}
)
ON CONFLICT (platform_post_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT
  post_id,
  platform,
  user_id,
  content,
  DATE_FORMAT(post_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS post_time_fmt,
  topic_tag,
  target_person,
  is_shareable,
  reason
FROM family_posts;
